subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw make five per-agent-capable memory role selectors a supported core plugin/config API, with the legacy memory selector removed from runtime routing after doctor migration?
rationale: This choice sets the durable ownership boundary between core routing and memory-plugin behavior, adds multiple public configuration keys, and determines whether existing installations must migrate before normal runtime.

options.title: Adopt a narrower staged contract
options.body: Approve an explicitly scoped role-selection API and migration behavior first, then land only the runtime and plugin surfaces needed for that supported contract.

options.title: Adopt the complete five-role model
options.body: Accept all five role selectors and per-agent overrides as a long-term supported contract, with owner-backed compatibility documentation and upgrade coverage.

options.title: Keep one canonical memory selector
options.body: Decline multi-role core routing and keep composition in existing plugin-specific or future external plugin seams.

recommendation.title: Adopt a narrower staged contract
recommendation.body: Approve an explicitly scoped role-selection API and migration behavior first, then land only the runtime and plugin surfaces needed for that supported contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history shows this contributor owns the current design and its compatibility rationale; a repository-history owner could not be established from the available read-only evidence.
